Synthetic ART / U-Boot images generated by `../make_fixtures.py`.

The structure matches the real SBE1V1K partitions (offsets, 64-byte vendor slots,
ath12k caldata header, U-Boot env CRC32) but every value is fake. A genuine ART
dump contains the unit's serial number, factory Wi-Fi passphrase and WPS PIN,
which must not be committed anywhere.

To validate the parser against a real dump without copying it in:

    SBEGW_ART_IMAGE=/path/to/p20-0_ART.img \
    SBEGW_ENV_IMAGE=/path/to/p17-0_APPSBLENV.img \
    python3 tests/smoke_art.py
